opening.argument: The material presents an online global hackathon to build Web3 projects on XDC Network. It gives the event a defined window, from October 17 to December 15, 2022, and lists project areas including Web3 wallets, DeFi projects, privacy dApps, dynamic NFTs, and open innovation. The “BUIDL the Future” message fits that event focus. The advertised possibility of up to $100,000 more backed by VC funding appears in this hackathon context; the material shown does not establish eligibility or award terms. It also shows no payment requirement or guaranteed return. Taken together, these are the features of an event promotion, not a promise of financial gain.

citations.quote: XDC Network teams up with some of the largest names in crypto for an online global hackathon to BUIDL the Future of Web3 on XDC Network.
